method: Raw records; step medians and extrema; atan2 and wrap bookkeeping only. No fitting, interpolation, smoothing, or gain conversion.
voltage_basis: RP requested command volts. Physical MDT input and piezo terminal voltages are not established by internal digital traces.

pi_crossing_brackets.note: Brackets from adjacent observed step medians; no interpolation. Includes drift and hysteresis.
